# SendMoi — Send links to Gmail in two taps
# https://send.moi

> SendMoi is a local-first iPhone, iPad, and Mac app that sends links, posts,
> notes, and photos through the user's own Gmail account as rich email cards.
> It supports editable drafts, saved recipients, Auto-send, and an offline queue.

## Product

- [SendMoi](https://send.moi/): Product overview, download links, demo, and frequently asked questions
- [Download on the App Store](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/sendmoi-share-links-to-self/id6760132875): SendMoi for iPhone, iPad, and Mac
